A SMALL WORLD, EXPLICITLY MODELED

A conversation you can look inside.

This is a working procedural sample, with a bounded English grammar. It understands supported subjects and constructions; it does not have a language model’s open-ended fluency.

  1. Ask each character where the exchange is.
  2. Amend the venue using the scenario controls.
  3. Ask again. Only Serein has received the new notice.
  4. Switch to free text and tell Iona: “The exchange is in Current Court.” Inspect the unverified testimony.
  5. Show the amended notice to Iona. Ask again, then ask “How do you know?”
  6. Send a lunar bulletin. Ask about the ship’s slot before and after advancing 12 minutes.

Rill participates from moving water. Expanded translation adds an authored social layer. Event venue and character location are separate facts.

Canon boundary: wider setting facts come from your world bible. All named visitors, local rooms, ship, event, and mutable scenario details are additions. The simulated 12-minute link is illustrative; no canonical orbit is implied.

The core, Solarpolis data, English interpreter, and IndexedDB adapter are separate modules. The World inspector is a director’s view; NPC answers use personal evidence only.
